meta.title: Arena
meta.subtitle: Site map · roadmap · living document
meta.foundation: Arena is built on top of the existing Launchpad codebase — reusing its working SSO and taxonomy as the base every section below inherits.

statuses.prog: In progress — ETA end of August

sections.name: Launchpad
sections.purpose: The entry section — where every user starts, personalized to their role.

items.name: Landing page
items.desc: Persona-based experience. Scope to be defined based on which products / feature flags are released.

items.name: AE Workspace
items.desc: Seller home — my deals, my territory, my tasks. Moved from Execution; folds into the Launchpad experience.

items.name: Manager Workspace
items.desc: Team rollups, rep performance, coaching. Moved from Execution; folds into the Launchpad experience.

items.name: Content Hub
items.desc: The working core: organize, govern, and find all GTM content.

children.name: Content Library
children.desc: Upload and classify documents and links; approval workflow to publish.

children.name: Spaces
children.desc: Curated hub pages built with a visual editor; public or restricted.

children.name: AI Search
children.desc: Keyword + semantic search across all content and spaces.

sections.name: Intelligence & Knowledge
sections.purpose: Made abstract and reused across all other pages, surfaced based on each page's context — not a standalone destination.

items.name: Knowledge Base
items.desc: Curated records — pain points, proof points, quotes, win-wires — reviewed by humans.

items.name: Content Generation
items.desc: Generate emails, battle cards, and narratives. Sync with what is already used in Arena for accounts.

items.name: Competitive Intelligence
items.desc: Competitor profiles and battle cards with fact-check QA.

sections.name: Revenue
sections.purpose: The numbers side — forecast, pipeline, and account truth for the whole org. ETA end of August.

items.name: Dashboard
items.desc: KPI overview and the daily starting point for revenue truth.

children.name: Day 1
children.desc: Quarter-start view: where the number stands from day one.

children.name: ARR Gameboard
children.desc: ARR details and vertical penetration gameboard.

children.name: Executive Summary
children.desc: A feature of the Dashboard (not a standalone page): AI-generated briefing for leadership.

items.name: Forecast
items.desc: Territory rollups and manual call adjustments. The single forecasting home in Arena.

children.name: Overview
children.desc: Current-quarter picture: commit, probable, upside, pipeline.

children.name: Linearity
children.desc: Close-date distribution across the quarter; risk clustering.

children.name: Bridge
children.desc: Bridge between forecast methodologies and periods.

items.name: Opportunities
items.desc: Full pipeline list with deal-detail drilldown, notes, and risk.

items.name: Accounts
items.desc: Account truth: list plus per-account deep dive.

children.name: Accounts Overview
children.desc: Account list with filters; high-value tracking and churn.

children.name: Account Hub
children.desc: Per-account drilldown: planning, activity, research, consumption.

items.name: Analytics
items.desc: Dropped per review — stage velocity / linearity estimates absorbed elsewhere or out of scope.

sections.name: AI & Agent Layer
sections.purpose: Slimmed per review: conversational AI only. Gateway and tooling dropped.

items.name: Conversational AI
items.desc: Account-scoped chat and on-page chat widgets.

items.name: Agent Gateway
items.desc: Dropped per review.

items.name: Operator Tooling
items.desc: Dropped per review.

sections.name: Admin
sections.purpose: Platform operations — access, data management, forecast configuration, integrations.

items.name: Users & Roles
items.desc: Role model and module permissions on top of the reused SSO.

items.name: Permissions
items.desc: Access based on predefined teams; territory assignment.

items.name: Data Upload
items.desc: Quota upload with Excel import.

items.name: Snapshots
items.desc: Check or generate bridge data on demand.

items.name: Forecast Settings
items.desc: Set thresholds for regions and account buckets.

items.name: General
items.desc: Generic variable data used across the app.

items.name: Integrations Settings
items.desc: Status per integration and last synced data.

items.name: Content Governance
items.desc: Review queues and taxonomy administration (taxonomy itself reused from the foundation).

items.name: Usage Analytics
items.desc: Adoption and engagement — active users, top and cold content.

items.name: Tenant Configuration
items.desc: Dropped per review — multi-tenant manifest system out of scope.

sections.name: Backlog
sections.purpose: Parked until the sections above land. Former Execution items now live here.

items.name: Build Your Number
items.desc: Bottom-up forecast builder for manager review.

items.name: My Actions & Alerts
items.desc: Task center plus threshold-based deal alerts.

items.name: Gameboard & Challenges
items.desc: Vertical penetration views, leaderboards, and contests.

items.name: SWAT
items.desc: Deal-rescue task forces — workstreams, risks, tasks, AI digests.

items.name: Case Ingestion
items.desc: Support-case data folded into account views.

items.name: External MCP Connector
items.desc: Expose capabilities to external AI clients; gated on data-egress policy.

items.name: Sales Plays & Positioning
items.desc: Additional intelligence output types beyond battle cards.
